nodes.label: Portable Shutdown Wakeup
nodes.rationale: macOS shutdown on a listening socket does not wake accept; bounded poll and nonblocking accept permit stop while retaining the fd until the thread joins.

nodes.label: Packaging transport boundary
nodes.rationale: Contributions preserve independent packaging and transport unless introducing an explicit transport layer.

nodes.label: Incremental Conformance Tests
nodes.rationale: Limit regressions by introducing wire semantics with tests at each phase.

nodes.label: Per Request Bidirectional Streams
nodes.rationale: Match responses to their request stream and reject invalid or duplicate terminal responses.

nodes.label: Version Gates
nodes.rationale: Preserve draft-14 and draft-16 behavior while introducing draft-18 semantics.

nodes.label: Full header production policy
nodes.rationale: Full LOCMAF headers allow queue trimming and arbitrary cached-object access without earlier delta state.

nodes.label: Per-Version Branching
nodes.rationale: Extend existing draft-specific branches to limit regressions; avoid a broad strategy refactor during additive draft support.

nodes.label: Bearer credential subset
nodes.rationale: DPoP proof generation and periodic revalidation are not claimed by the initial publisher subset.

nodes.label: Separate Moof Requirement
nodes.rationale: One traf per moof avoids multiplexed fragments rejected by the live and LOCMAF parsers.

nodes.label: Transport Ordering Governs Broadcast End
nodes.rationale: The transport draft forbids PUBLISH_DONE before all future streams close, so final catalog transmission precedes PUBLISH_DONE despite MSF bullet ordering.

nodes.label: Control Capacity Reservation
nodes.rationale: Reserve control capacity separately so media queue saturation cannot block alias establishment or subscription termination.

nodes.label: Layer Separation
nodes.rationale: Keep MoQT draft churn in the session layer while QUIC and WebTransport adapters remain byte-stream transports.
